messages:
anya: Heads-up — proposal to change audit event shape. Plan is to add `actor_role` and `session_id` and remove `executor_ip` (PII concerns). Need to decide versioning + migration window. Tagging @mike @sam for ops implications.

mike: Removing `executor_ip` will break some customers' ad-hoc tooling. Can we make it optional first and emit a deprecation header? Also +1 on a version field in the envelope (e.g. `audit_v`).

sam: My suggestion: add an `audit_v` integer at top-level, default to 1 for current events. Emit `audit_v:2` for new shape. Keep `executor_ip` present but nullable for 90 days, then remove in v3. Provide a validation endpoint so customers can submit sample payloads.

zara: From RBAC perspective: `actor_role` is useful but we should normalize values (no freeform org-internal titles). Propose a small enum and a freeform `actor_role_raw` behind a flag. Also worried about role leakage for hosted customers — consider redaction rules. On KMS: if we start encrypting `actor_id` or `session_id`, we need to measure unwrap latency in the query path.

dina: Migration ops thoughts: feature-flag gating + canary on Dedicated clusters. We should provision a staging bucket that receives both v1 and v2 events, run consumer adapters for both. Also need a rollback plan if search indexes break.

anya: sample v2 payload (draft):
```
{
  "audit_v": 2,
  "timestamp": "2028-04-22T14:58:12Z",
  "event_type": "resource.update",
  "actor_id": "enc:AAAA...",  // encrypted with KMS or redacted for hosted
  "actor_role": "platform_admin",
  "session_id": "s_3f6a9b2",
  "resource": { "type": "model", "id": "m-xyz" }
}
```

mike: A couple of infra asks: 1) API/SDKs need soft-fail compatibility so older clients keep working; 2) validators in SDKs and our event-ingest should surface schema warnings (not hard errors) for 60 days. We can add a `X-Audit-Deprecation` header to responses.

sam: Indexing note — we should avoid backfilling `actor_role` into historical docs; instead update adapters so search queries understand both shapes. Backfill is heavy and not necessary for compliance queries.

zara: KMS specifics: Private customers should be able to provide KMS key ARN to envelope-encrypt `actor_id` in logs. For hosted, we'll use our RW KMS with HSM wrapping; we must document performance impact: ~5-15ms per unwrap if done synchronously. Consider caching unwrapped tokens in the serving layer for short TTL.

dina: Communications: draft timeline: draft schema -> 2w review -> validator + staging run 1w -> canary 2w -> gradual cutover 8w -> deprecation notice 6 months after cutover. Customer-facing items: migration guide, sample payloads, JS/Python snippets, and a deprecation FAQ.

anya: Action items (owners):
1) PR for schema draft + enum list for `actor_role` (anya)
2) validator endpoint + sample payloads + SDK warnings (mike)
3) rollout doc + staging + canary checklist (sam)
4) deprecation email + customer guide (anya + dina)
Please ack and add any missing pieces.

mike: :thumbsup: ack. I'll spin up the validator service repo and wire the linter.

sam: Ack. I'll draft the canary runbook and add search adapter changes.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: validator-service v0.1 -> staging (build 1256) — 2028-04-22T15:17:02Z

anya: Nice, thanks. Let's huddle tomorrow 14:00 PT to finalize timelines and publish the PR branch.

zara: One more: add an opt-in telemetry flag so Private customers can test schema changes without affecting logs retention SLA.

mike: Good catch — will include opt-in flag in validator API.
